purpose: Source-backed pre-integration contract baseline, NOT proof of runtime integration

sourceBaselines.backend: Current eShop Backend after implementation/cleanup/refactor; full local release suites passed 2026-11-07, receipt now historical after source edits. Web integration tracked separately in contracts/web-integration.v1.json.

canonicalRules.ids: Backend UUIDs are canonical; demo IDs are not import IDs
canonicalRules.money: Integer minor units and ISO 4217 currency; UI USD decimal display is a presentation adapter only
canonicalRules.inventory: Stock changed only through Inventory API after item creation; product/variant stockOnHand are mirrors
canonicalRules.availability: Display hint only, authoritative stock validated by checkout backend
canonicalRules.auth: Domain API remains Bearer JWT-only. Owner-approved persistent web sessions use a limited same-origin Next auth bridge with HttpOnly cookies for refresh credentials, access tokens in memory and fresh backend identity/grants; mobile/API contracts unchanged.
canonicalRules.status: Explicit map ACTIVE/DRAFT/ARCHIVED; never silently map ARCHIVED to Draft
canonicalRules.media: Canonical verified media IDs, signed provider-specific upload/complete and reference-aware gallery/deletion APIs. Existing rendition/reconcile tooling; actual external provider/CDN/deployment validation remains separate.
canonicalRules.pagination: Existing {items,total,page,limit,pages} needs a frontend adapter to ApiPage.pageSize or additive backend alias
canonicalRules.apiStability: Keep /v1 and legacy endpoints stable; add new documented DTOs without breaking already-tested clients
canonicalRules.cart: Canonical guest/customer cart and login merge; customer JWT for configured country/currency checkout estimates, bounded reservations and unpaid order creation. Existing STRIPE_TEST-only payment capability; no guest checkout, automatic FX or address-specific tax inference.

findings.summary: notifications persisted inbox/read/preferences/templates and outbox subscriber are source-present; Admin bell remains a placeholder and Storefront has no operational inbox
findings.action: Implement authenticated own-inbox/preferences UI and typed target navigation. Staff alerts follow current permissions; security history remains mandatory; marketing channels default off. Activate the bounded dispatcher only with reviewed deployment/provider configuration. Email/push delivery remain separate email and push transports; no live browser acceptance from this audit.

findings.summary: email delivery independent email queue, SMTP adapter, safe submission history and owner template/status APIs are source-present; live provider and browser action flows remain unaccepted
findings.action: Build OWNER readiness/template/history UI without exposing credentials. Add Storefront /verify-email and /reset-password fragment-token pages calling existing one-time confirmation APIs. SMTP ACCEPTED means submission only. Keep customer identity email acceptance pending until controlled provider and token flows are validated; never publish SMTP secrets in either frontend.

findings.summary: push messaging owned encrypted device lifecycle, FCM provider and approved rich campaign/inbox contracts are source-present; both web apps still need push/service-worker integration
findings.action: Implement explicit browser permission, per-installation registration/refresh/revoke on sign-out, client token rotation on account switch, and authenticated typed target resolution. Build marketing composer/preview/OWNER approval/schedule/metrics. Provider acceptance is not device display; actual Firebase/worker/frontend validation remains pending. Flutter comes after full web E2E.

findings.summary: Live payments page reads server attempt/collection records and lifetime refund strings; other financial/dashboard/report/CSV adapters remain step 7. All new runtime validation is deferred.
findings.action: Replace booked/fulfillment-derived sample revenue with verified TEST collections and confirmed refunds on independent event dates. Preserve currency groups/exact minor-unit strings, UTC exclusive-to bounds and current inventory basis. Hide domain-restricted sections, require extra catalog/customer grants for performance data, and use bounded audited CSV. No live UI/runtime acceptance from source audit.
